# MiniSearch

Vendored MiniSearch 7.2.0 UMD distribution, MIT license (included).
Upstream: https://github.com/lucaong/minisearch
Documentation: https://lucaong.github.io/minisearch/
Package source: https://registry.npmjs.org/minisearch/-/minisearch-7.2.0.tgz

The exact upstream distribution is retained without changes. It is loaded from
1AGE's own origin only when search is used. No npm install or CDN is required
for visitors, builds or tests.
